items.title: Hebron municipality: Some 5,000 residents still impacted by IDF operation in city
items.summary: Operation launched last week, after shooting attack killed 2 soldiers, continues, 6 detained in nearby villages; IDF says footage of soldier beating Palestinian detainee under review
